title: Why: trained on the shape
text: Trained on huge amounts of consistently tagged structured text. Documents where title, content, and category always sat inside predictable markup. That built a strong expectation for those shapes. Text that matches the shape it learned gets processed more coherently. Text that doesn't gets processed less well.
